result.summary: Introduces a `with_sanitizer_env.py` wrapper script to centralize default sanitizer environment options across CI, documentation, and test runners. Applies these defaults automatically to functional tests and enables ThreadSanitizer's `enable_adaptive_delay=1` setting by default.
result.problem: Default sanitizer environment settings were duplicated across multiple locations (CI configuration, test runners, and documentation), making them tedious to update and requiring developers to manually configure flags when running sanitizer builds locally. Furthermore, TSAN was run without adaptive delay, which can miss rare race conditions.

PR description: 'enable https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ThreadSanitizer.html#adaptive-delay, which may help to find some kind of rare races more frequently.'
result.scope_notes: Touches test harness scripts and documentation; the full diff was omitted from the prompt.
result.card: Centralizes default sanitizer environment settings into a new with_sanitizer_env.py wrapper script, applying them automatically to functional test runs. This de-duplicates sanitizer options previously scattered across CI, docs, and test runners, making it easier for developers to run sanitized tests locally. It also enables ThreadSanitizer's enable_adaptive_delay=1 by default to increase the likelihood of catching rare data races.
